text:
Mia K: Heads-up: launching benchmark + webinar next Wed. Need X + LinkedIn cadence and final asset thumbs. Can we lock copy + creative by EOD tomorrow? Also want a small paid push after the webinar. @Priya S
Sam T: On it. Drafting 3 variants for X (short thread, stat image post, CTA post). Will paste copies here in a bit.
Jordan P: I can take the visuals. What’s the primary stat we want to lead with? Branded chart or model-output screenshot?
Mia K: Primary stat = 2.7x token throughput at p99 vs baseline. Use 2.7x as the headline. Include a "see methodology" link to the blog. Prefer model-output screenshot for credibility, but keep a clean chart for the hero image.
Sam T: Draft copies — dropping quick variants:
```
X thread variant (threaded):
1/ Benchmark: 2.7x token throughput at p99 vs baseline. We built Redwood Inference to make production LLM serving predictable and cheap. Thread 👇
2/ How we measured: real-world traces, p99 token latency, same model weights. See our blog for the full methodology: https://redwood.ai/blog/bench (link)
3/ Join our webinar Wed for a live walkthrough + Q&A — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar

LinkedIn short:
Redwood Inference benchmark shows 2.7x token throughput (p99) vs baseline. Join our webinar next Wed to see how we measure and how teams can improve inference economics. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar

Single-image stat post:
2.7x token throughput at p99 — new benchmark from Redwood Inference. Read the blog + register for the webinar: https://redwood.ai/blog/bench
```
Jordan P: For the stat image I'll need the raw chart + screenshot assets. Also confirm export sizes: LinkedIn prefers 1200x675, X hero wants 1600x900. I'll set up Figma slices.
Sam T: Mock filenames I'll attach to the ticket: bench-2.7x-chart.png, bench-webinar-hero.png, model-output-snap.png.
Priya S: Quick budget note — propose $3k initial LinkedIn boost and $1k X for 2 weeks post-webinar. Also need UTMs so Growth can route inbound leads properly. Who owns the registration form / routing? @Alex B
Alex B: Sales Ops will own the form and routing. I'll create a gated reg form with hidden UTM fields and tag campaign = "bench-webinar-mar2026". Routing: leads -> SFDC queue "Inbound: Bench Webinar" and rotate AEs. Ping me final UTM string and I'll wire it up.
Mia K: Sam, please update CTAs with utm_source and utm_campaign params and add a clear "Request demo" CTA on the webinar page.
social-scheduler-bot: Draft schedule created: 
- X thread (with thread image): Wed 09:00 PT
- LinkedIn post (hero + post copy): Wed 10:30 PT
- Paid boost start: Thu 00:00 PT
Use /schedule <ts> --confirm to lock slots.
Jordan P: Uploaded Figma concept: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/bench-assets (placeholder). Added two export slices and a notes layer for alt text.
Sam T: Copy updated with UTMs: https://redwood.ai/blog/bench?utm_campaign=bench-webinar-mar2026&utm_source=x (will mirror for LinkedIn). Adding alt text and short thread CTA variations.
Mia K: Final ask — engagement plan for the first 48hrs post and reply templates. Can Growth own quick replies and AE handoff language? @Priya S
Priya S: Yep. I'll draft 3 reply templates: 1) demo interest, 2) pricing inquiry, 3) technical deep-dive. Will share by EOD.
Alex B: SFDC queue ready for test. Send a test registration once CTAs are live and I'll confirm it surfaces in the queue.
Mia K: Great work. If nothing else, let's reconvene tomorrow 11:00am PT to review final assets and lock schedule. :thumbsup:
